feature: Experts source (consensus of N experts per type x scoring x position)
detail: No expert feed exists. Big board's 'Expert consensus' (use-board-sources.ts useConsensusBoard) is actually the user cred-weighted consensus_rankings view. persona_source_rankings (021) is service-role only and its scraper (scripts/scrape-persona-sources.ts) has no sources, and the standing rule is RSS/YouTube only with no scraping. Needs a source plus ingestion, or a ruling to use AI personas.

feature: Scout AI ranking per type x scoring x position

feature: Users source (average of N user rankings per type x scoring x position)

detail: Today: weekly_rankings table (001, unused by any code), big_board_weekly (cross-position, per week, no scoring) and the season big board (serving as both Pre draft and ROS). No ROS type, no scoring, no status. The Mine tab, Your rank, community rankings and Create all depend on it.

detail: Depends on the typed ranking model. Public lists and their owners exist (use-explore-feed.ts), but not as type/position/scoring rankings with a submitted time.

detail: No accuracy grading job. The cred_scores and profiles.cred_rank columns and weekly_rankings.accuracy_score exist but stay empty (spec-submissions-cred.md).

detail: profiles.follower_count plus the follows table and useToggleFollow (use-follows.ts). Needs compact count formatting. Follows are keyed by author in the app.

detail: New UI that needs per-expert ranks and the user's ranking.
